summary: Security fix (SSRF): the LDAP 'test connection' action now refuses local/private network addresses (unless ALLOW_INTERNAL_IP_CONNECTIONS or dev mode), matching the check already done when saving/updating an LDAP config.

statements.why: Change only adds blockLocalAndPrivateIpAddresses(url) at ldap-config-service.ts:1046; tightens, introduces no risk.

statements.text: The agent changed backend/src/ee/services/ldap-config/ldap-config-service.ts in a way plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what it does differently.
statements.why: True but hides a security fix.

misses.what: Security fix: an org admin with LDAP permissions could previously use 'Test LDAP connection' to make the server connect to internal/private network addresses (server-side request forgery); that is now blocked, as it already was for saving the config.

Self-hosted installs whose LDAP server is on a private IP will now see 'Local IPs not allowed' when testing the connection unless ALLOW_INTERNAL_IP_CONNECTIONS is set (saving was already blocked the same way).
